runtime_prompt_en:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: held-out semantic rendering test
Input images: Image 1 supplies facial appearance only; the frozen prompt supplies wardrobe, pose, scene, framing, and lighting.
Reference guidance: Maintain Image 1's overall face length, eye aperture and spacing, brow line, nose and lip shape, lower-face and jaw width, cheek structure, skin tone, and natural asymmetry while portraying one original fictional adult woman.
Primary request: Photorealistic square head-to-knees portrait of one clearly adult original woman in a flooded lunar archive refitted as a pressure-safe domestic study. In an adult restrained three-quarter view where both side contours remain visible, beside a glass cabinet she is decoding a palm-sized storm trapped inside it by aligning three copper tuning rings. A miniature aurora crosses her waist; glacial-cyan reflections rise from the flooded floor and contour her face. Her structured black-and-copper observatory uniform is practical, fully clothed, close-collared. Render a neutral hourglass silhouette relation: the upper torso expands above the waist around a comparatively narrower natural waist, then the hips expand below the waist; smooth transitions, pose viewpoint and garment cinching declared separately, fabric following form. Preserve stable facial appearance indicated by the reference image. In a slight three-quarter facial crop with soft form light across the upper lip, model the philtral contour as two philtral columns around a central philtral groove descending into a double upper-lip arc. Eye-level 50 mm, natural skin, wet reflections, smoke glass, oxidized copper, restrained haze; prioritize the storm interaction and aurora boundary.
Avoid: 3D render look, distorted fingers, over-processed retouching, cartoon style, unrealistic hands, broken facial features, low resolution, excessive HDR, body distortion
